title: Emergent Prethermal Symmetries for Scalable Hamiltonian Learning
summary: Learning an interacting many-body Hamiltonian at the Heisenberg limit generally requires control that preserves local information for evolution times of order $1/\varepsilon$ to attain $\varepsilon$ precision. To achieve this, existing protocols often rely on trusted many-qubit operations or increasingly rapid control pulses, creating a precision barrier when gates involve unknown multi-qubit interaction or have finite duration.
